_note: Facts published after the 30-Sep-2026 as-of date. Kept for the record and for a future update; NOT used in the initiation report, model or valuation.

facts.item: Q2FY27 results: revenue Rs2,617 cr (+28% YoY), Screener-basis EBITDA Rs349 cr (13.3% margin), net profit Rs5 cr; results call held 28-Oct-2026.
Motilal Oswal: Buy, target Rs270 (from Rs230) after a Q2FY27 beat (revenue +11%, EBITDA +56% vs estimates).
ICICI Securities: Buy, target Rs290 (from Rs245), 'CDMO momentum gathering steam'.
HDFC Mutual Fund cut its holding from 7.015% to 4.988% (SAST disclosure 31-Oct-2026).
Board approved exercising a call option to acquire the balance 26% equity of Yapan Bio.
